name: Infer: llama.cpp server
short_desc: llama.cpp llama-server (GGUF Q8_0) with MTP drafts, unified KV and Anthropic API
author: Morteza Rastgoo
description: llama.cpp llama-server build 12679 (CUDA 13, native sm_120 kernels), pinned by digest. Serves a GGUF conversion of the model (Q8_0) with its vision projector, flash attention, q8_0 KV in one unified buffer shared by all slots, context checkpoints for the hybrid (Gated DeltaNet) layers, a host-RAM prompt cache (--cache-ram), native MTP speculative decoding (--spec-type draft-mtp, from the NextN tensors kept in the GGUF), Prometheus /metrics, /slots, and OpenAI plus Anthropic /v1/messages APIs. Limits: no request priority, and GPU_FRAC is ignored (VRAM use follows the KV pool size).

form_fields.label: Models directory (host)
form_fields.hint: Host folder with your model weights. It is mounted read-only at the same path.

form_fields.label: Model path (GGUF)
form_fields.hint: GGUF file made with llama.cpp convert_hf_to_gguf.py (see the bake-off README).

form_fields.label: Vision projector (mmproj GGUF)
form_fields.hint: mmproj file from convert_hf_to_gguf.py --mmproj, or `none` for text only.

form_fields.label: Served model name
form_fields.hint: Name clients send in the `model` field.

form_fields.label: GPU memory fraction
form_fields.hint: Fraction of total VRAM for weights + KV. Smoke test: 0.10.

form_fields.label: Speculative tokens (MTP)
form_fields.hint: Native MTP draft tokens. 0 disables. The DSpine DFlash draft is not portable.

form_fields.label: MPS VRAM cap
form_fields.hint: CUDA_MPS_PINNED_DEVICE_MEM_LIMIT. Smoke test with host vLLM running: 0=12G.

form_fields.label: Chat template
form_fields.hint: Jinja file, or `none` for the model's own template (use `none` for the smoke model).

form_fields.label: Extra engine args
form_fields.hint: Appended verbatim to the engine command.

form_fields.label: KV pool (tokens, all slots)
form_fields.hint: -c with a unified KV buffer: total tokens shared by all slots; one request may use all of it.

form_fields.label: Host-RAM prompt cache (GB)
form_fields.hint: --cache-ram: idle slot states kept in host RAM for reuse. 0 disables.
